frozen_content_sealed.registered_verdict: G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4a AND G4b — a five-way conjunction
frozen_content_sealed.G1: flip beats the definite-direction ceiling: p_F > 0.919746 at >=5 sigma, aggregate over 21 pairs. THRESHOLD test against an in-house bound (C5014 category rule).
frozen_content_sealed.G2: ordering flip > parallel: p_F - p_P >= 5 sigma
frozen_content_sealed.G3: ordering parallel > switch: p_P - p_S >= 5 sigma — the order-vs-direction separation
frozen_content_sealed.G4a: parallel apparatus-health, POSITIVE and MISSABLE: p_P in [0.75, 0.90] (ideal 0.8653; a dead apparatus reads ~0.62 and FAILS)
frozen_content_sealed.G4b: switch apparatus-health, POSITIVE and MISSABLE: p_S in [0.63, 0.78] (ideal 0.7143; dead ~0.62 sits at the edge and fails jointly with G3)
frozen_content_sealed.reported_not_registered: R1 per-pair win tables incl. the Pauli-subset saturation check (Elder's finding); R2 landscape {parallel-SDP 0.8827, causal-SDP 0.9056, dtd 0.9197} overlaid with measured arms; R3 flip per-pair minimum
frozen_content_sealed.budget: ~42k shots ~ 3-6 QPU-s on ALT2 — the cheapest flight on the board
frozen_content_sealed.kill_conditions: KA fence: walker over AS-BUILT pubs reproduces every section-3 ideal at 1e-9 (flip=1/pair, parallel=0.865308, switch=0.714286), non-completion = FAIL; depth HOLD any transpiled pub > 150 2q gates (bar stated PRE-transpile against a ~110 estimate); calibration hold median 2q > 0.5%; pool re-read at submission, overdraw = not submitted

observations_recorded_at_seal.NO_GATE_HERE_CAN_PASS_TRIVIALLY_AND_THAT: The text states it outright: 'every control gates on a POSITIVE prediction it can miss; nothing is satisfiable by a dead apparatus (a fully depolarized flight fails G1, G2, G4a simultaneously).' This is the direct answer to what I recorded on H10-C2 hours earlier — there G2 PASSED trivially because everything read zero, and I logged that its pass carried NO independent weight. Here the health gates are BANDS with a floor: a dead apparatus reads ~0.62 and FAILS G4a/G4b rather than sailing through. A control that cannot fail is not a control, and this prereg is built so none of them can be satisfied by wash.
observations_recorded_at_seal.THE_DEPTH_BAR_IS_STATED_PRE_TRANSPILE: 150 2q gates against a ~110 estimate, with the bar written down BEFORE the transpiler runs — same discipline as C2, where the estimate was stated up front and the transpiler's actual number given the deciding vote. A hold set after seeing the number is not a hold.
observations_recorded_at_seal.CHEAPEST_FLIGHT_ON_THE_BOARD: 3-6 QPU-s. For scale: C1's pilot cost 12 QPU-s to return NO-FLY and C2 cost ~60 to return DOES NOT HOLD. This one is cheaper than either negative, and its bars are Elder's already-computed ceilings rather than new estimates.
